name: Bulk actions bar
purpose: Controlled batch actions for the current selected record set, with asynchronous operation feedback.
description: Act on a selection without repeating the same change row by row.

guidance.overview: Controlled batch actions for the current selected record set, with asynchronous operation feedback.
usage: Pass the real selected count and callbacks that operate on the same selection. A zero count renders no bar.
Provide owners for assignment and return promises from mutation callbacks to enable pending guards and visible failures.
Place the bar in the grid toolbar selection slot rather than duplicating it elsewhere in the layout.
accessibility: Actions are labeled controls; the selection count explains their scope.
Escape clears selection, and pending operations prevent duplicate activation. Restore a useful toolbar focus target after clearing.
context: Use for owner and lifecycle updates across selected records; do not offer operations the host cannot apply consistently.
